panels.title: 边缘拒绝与拉黑 · 不把源站 403 当作已确认拦截

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(blocked=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT countIf(block_reason='域名访问控制') AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT countIf(blocked=1 AND status=429) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT countIf(origin_seen=1 AND status=403) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT uniqExactIf(ip,action='APPLIED' AND applied=1) AS value FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote})

SELECT uniqExactIf(ban_id,action='APPLIED' AND applied=1) AS value FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote})

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,block_reason AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: L7 / L3 拉黑决策趋势
panels.description: 以 L7/L3 两条实际决策序列展示；无新增决策为 0，采集不可用时留空。

targets.rawSql:
WITH greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS step,
intDiv(intDiv(${__from},1000),step)*step AS first_bucket,
intDiv(intDiv(${__to},1000),step)*step AS last_bucket
SELECT toDateTime(bucket,'UTC') AS time,concat('L',toString(layer)) AS metric,
if((SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1) FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node))=(SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),toNullable(ifNull(decisions,0)),NULL) AS value
FROM (SELECT toInt64(first_bucket+number*step) AS bucket,arrayJoin([toUInt8(7),toUInt8(3)]) AS layer
      FROM numbers(toUInt64(intDiv(last_bucket-first_bucket,step)+1))) AS timeline
LEFT JOIN (SELECT toInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(step)))) AS bucket,
                  layer,uniqExact(ban_id) AS decisions FROM scdn.bans
           WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND layer IN (7,3) AND action='APPLIED' AND applied=1
           GROUP BY bucket,layer) AS measured USING(bucket,layer)
ORDER BY time,metric

SELECT ip AS IP,count() AS `拦截数`,any(country) AS `国家`,any(operator) AS `ASN机构_运营商`,uniqExact(uri) AS `URI数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY ip ORDER BY `拦截数` DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT uri AS URI,count() AS `拦截数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY uri ORDER BY `拦截数` DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT host AS Host,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拒绝数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND site='__unregistered__' GROUP BY host ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT country AS `国家`,count() AS `拦截数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY country ORDER BY `拦截数` DESC

panels.title: 封禁审计与当前执行视图
所选期间审计事件
panels.description: 0 表示所选时间和范围内无审计记录，不代表采集器关闭。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote})

panels.title: 当前生效封禁 IP
panels.description: 最新执行视图按 IP 去重；没有活动封禁时为 0，缺少新采样时显示采集不可用。

targets.rawSql: SELECT if((SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1) FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node))=(SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),(SELECT uniqExactIf(ip,ip!='') FROM (SELECT JSONExtractString(record,'ip') ip FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(records)) record FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node) WHERE seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1) WHERE (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR JSONExtractInt(record,'internal')=0) AND (JSONExtractString(record,'scope')='*' OR JSONExtractString(record,'scope') IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}))),NULL) AS value

panels.title: 封禁采集健康度
panels.description: 最近 60 秒有新采样且 Ban 内核视图就绪的已选节点比例。

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1)/nullIf((SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),0) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

panels.title: 封禁采样延迟
panels.description: 已选节点最旧一次快照距今的秒数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(dateDiff('second',seen,now())) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

options.content: **没有活动封禁时显示 0，下面的执行表为空属于正常状态。** 审计受时间、节点、站点、IP 和请求范围筛选；默认公网不含内网测试。[查看近 7 天历史（含内网/测试）](/d/scdn-native-security?from=now-7d&to=now&var-node=$__all&var-site=$__all&var-country=$__all&var-scope=all&var-ip=&var-uri=)。国家和 URI 条件只筛选 HTTP 请求面板。

targets.rawSql: WITH ph_records AS (SELECT time AS `时间`,node AS `执行节点`,ip AS IP,scope AS `站点范围`,concat('L',toString(layer)) AS `层级`,action AS `动作`,reason AS `原因`,origin AS `来源`,ban_id AS `决策ID` FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100) SELECT * FROM ph_records UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime64(3,'UTC'))),'无符合筛选的审计记录','—','—','—','无记录','当前时间与筛选范围没有封禁审计记录','—','—' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ph_records)

panels.title: 当前活动封禁 · 节点去重前视图
panels.description: 来自当前只读执行视图，时间筛选不改变当前状态。IP/站点筛选有效；URI 只过滤 HTTP 请求面板，封禁审计不记录原始 URI。L3 丢包没有 HTTP 请求日志。

targets.rawSql: WITH ph_records AS (SELECT node AS `节点`,JSONExtractString(record,'ip') AS IP,JSONExtractString(record,'scope') AS `站点范围`,JSONExtractInt(record,'layer') AS `层级`,JSONExtractString(record,'ban_id') AS `决策ID` FROM (SELECT node,arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(records)) record FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node) WHERE seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE (${ip:singlequote}='' OR IP=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR JSONExtractInt(record,'internal')=0) AND (JSONExtractString(record,'scope')='*' OR JSONExtractString(record,'scope') IN (${site:singlequote})) ORDER BY node,IP) SELECT * FROM ph_records UNION ALL SELECT if((SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1) FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node))=(SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),'当前无生效封禁','执行视图采集不可用'),'—','—',CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Int64)),'—' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ph_records)

panels.title: 原生 L3 内核计数 · 自采集启用起
内核 DROP 累计（含自检）
panels.description: 各节点当前内核 Map 累计；包含接入前与内核自检执行，不是 HTTP 请求数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1 AND isNotNull(counter))=(SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),sumIf(counter,seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1 AND isNotNull(counter)),NULL) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

defaults.displayName: 内核 DROP 累计（含自检）

panels.title: 所选期间有效内核采样
panels.description: 正数表示有实际内核计数采样；它与 DROP 增量是不同统计。

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(isNotNull(kernel_drop_counter)) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote})

defaults.displayName: 所选期间有效内核采样

panels.title: 内核采集健康度
panels.description: 最近 60 秒有实际原生 Map 数值、Ban 就绪的已选节点比例。

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1 AND isNotNull(counter))/nullIf((SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),0) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

SELECT max(dateDiff('second',seen,now())) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

options.content: **累计值**是当前内核 Map 保存的 DROP 计数（含旧自检）；**期间增量/速率为 0** 表示采集期间没有新增 DROP。健康度不足 100% 表示需要检查采集，不能将缺失数据当成零。内核统计只按节点筛选，不按 HTTP 站点、国家、IP 或 URI 拆分。

panels.title: L3 丢弃计数增量
panels.description: 原生 eBPF DROP 计数器增量，包含内核自检执行；不是 HTTP 请求数，不能与 HTTP 拦截相加。不按站点/国家拆分。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumOrNull(kernel_drop_delta) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote})

panels.title: L3 丢弃速率
panels.description: 从真实内核 Map 只读采样；首次采样或计数器重置时留空，不伪造为零。

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(kernel_drop_pps) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time
